goals.objective: Implement PLAN.md in full — a lean watchlist-only top-three shortlist contract (tier-then-rank by executable-bid premium velocity, truthful Moomoo quote evidence, one immutable run workflow) — while strictly adhering to production-ready-vibe-coding-rules V6.0.md (question requirements, delete aggressively, minimal diffs, verify trust boundaries, never commit plan/rules/secrets).

tasks.title: Unify strategy configuration
tasks.verificationContract: Selected-preset propagation is an OptionsService responsibility; explicit base + selected-preset merge in watchlist_manager; retired growth/VIX overlays deleted; preset versions bumped. test_presets.py and test_watchlist_manager.py pass.
tasks.evidence: Preset versions bumped to v2 in core/presets.py; WatchlistManager.get_screening_profile now merges the active preset's flat screener profile (PUT-specific csp_* keys + generic liquidity floors) so sco

tasks.title: Fix capital and coverage invariants
tasks.verificationContract: CSP capacity = true cash minus reserved short-put collateral (never margin buying power); /api/options/cash-status delegates; coverage is all-symbol scan or planning (never truncated). test_portfolio_context.py + coverage-invariant test pass.
tasks.evidence: CSP capacity now uses true available cash minus reserved short-put collateral (portfolio_context.py both refresh and cached paths); margin buying_power is display-only. /api/options/cash-status delega

tasks.title: Make broker evidence truthful
tasks.verificationContract: Moomoo update_time + UTC fetch time retained; US timestamps parsed via zoneinfo(America/New_York); crossed markets hard-block, locked markets valid; invalid/missing/stale broker time fails closed while market open; underlying type batched. test_connection.py + test_wheel_decision.py pass.

tasks.title: Centralize qualification and math
tasks.verificationContract: Backend computes bid velocity, cycle/annualized yield, midpoint limit target, quality tier, event tier, review_only, safe recommended quantity, and machine-readable rationale once. test_score_regression.py + test_wheel_decision.py pass.

tasks.title: Apply deterministic ranking
tasks.verificationContract: Ordering tuple (quality, event, -bid velocity, ticker, expiry, strike) + diversity safeguard; composite score cannot break a premium-velocity tie (proven in test). test_recommendations.py passes.

tasks.title: Correct run actionability
tasks.verificationContract: Per-symbol quote evidence built from candidate data; pure read-time stale/tradeable evaluation on /api/run read without mutating persisted snapshot (state flips after deadline, stored JSON unchanged). test_run_model.py passes.

tasks.title: Collapse to one runtime workflow
tasks.verificationContract: Dashboard cards/refresh consume /api/run + /api/run/refresh; last-good cards visible during attempts/failures; copy disabled unless snapshot.tradeable && signal.copy_eligible. test_routes_run.py passes.

tasks.title: Delete superseded code
tasks.verificationContract: /api/options/top-recommendations, RecommendationCache, core/cache_manager.py, legacy adapters, browser rank math, retired growth/Best-Plays, and obsolete/duplicate tests removed; all in-repo consumers updated atomically; no remaining references. test_routes_options.py passes.

tasks.title: Expose only decision evidence
tasks.verificationContract: Cards show bid velocity headline, midpoint limit-target wording, quality/event tier, recommended-vs-max quantity, review-only rationale; composite/POP/EV secondary and explicitly caveated; ticket text uses recommended_contracts (no silent default to 1/max). tests/frontend/top-recommendations.test.js passes.

tasks.title: Version and document
tasks.verificationContract: Preset/scoring/run-payload versions bumped; scan_ledger JSON includes premium basis/tiers; SCORING.md rewritten; API.md/README.md/CHANGELOG.md/tests/README.md + owning DOX updated for changed methodology/endpoints/manual-smoke; dormant trade-event schema/data untouched. test_scan_ledger.py + test_wheel_parity.py pass.

tasks.title: Verify narrow-to-broad
tasks.verificationContract: Focused pytest list + npm top-recommendations test pass; then ruff check, ruff format --check, full pytest, npm test --silent, and hygiene/no-execution-surface tests pass; manual Windows/OpenD smoke steps documented (requires OpenD, may need user execution).
